source.note: 2000 UD Ionix Baseball hobby product. VCS intentionally keeps both the 90-card flagship checklist and the 90-card Reciprocal parallel intact as single ProductSets so collection-completion percentages reflect the full collector checklists. Historical range-specific scarcity is retained in notes/metadata rather than splitting either checklist.

decisions.baseStructure: Checklist #1-90 is one VCS Base ProductSet. Cards #61-90 retain Futuristics subset metadata.
decisions.baseScarcityModeling: VCS intentionally sacrifices the historical 1:4 scarcity of #61-90 and gives all #1-90 equal Base availability. This preserves a true 90-card set-completion percentage.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: No base cards receive an RC suffix. TCDB's rookie index and Beckett both report zero recognized true RCs for 2000 UD Ionix Baseball. Futuristics wording alone does not qualify as RC.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus RC when independently verified. FUT, AU, MEM, EXCH, print-run, error/correction, and other notes are stored in subset/variant metadata instead of Player.
decisions.reciprocalModeling: Reciprocal R1-R90 is one VCS ProductSet with equal card availability. Historically R1-R60 were inserted 1:4 packs and R61-R90 at 1:11; VCS intentionally uses one set-wide 1:4 rate so the full 90-card Reciprocal checklist has one completion percentage. R61-R90 retain Futuristics subset metadata.
decisions.obsoleteSetCleanup: An earlier applied draft used a separate Reciprocal Futuristics ProductSet. That obsolete ProductSet is explicitly listed for guarded cleanup before the consolidated draft is applied.
decisions.administrativeInsertHandling: Upper Deck Collection Entry Forms and UD Authentics Redemption slips are excluded as administrative/sweepstakes/redemption instruments rather than collectible card outcomes. The 13-card UD Authentics autograph checklist is modeled directly; redemption-fulfilled subjects retain EXCH metadata where applicable.
decisions.clementeModeling: The three Roberto Clemente A Piece of History 3000 Hit Club cards distributed through UD Ionix are included as one insert ProductSet. Their PR350/SN5/SN4 and memorabilia/autograph attributes are preserved per card; no unsupported pack odds are inferred.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing and images are reviewed. Equal-odds simplifications for Base and Reciprocal are intentional for VCS collection-completion behavior; unsupported Clemente memorabilia odds remain null rather than guessed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-90. Cards #61-90 retain Futuristics subset metadata but have equal VCS Base availability with #1-60.

productSets.name: Reciprocal
productSets.notes: Complete Reciprocal checklist R1-R90. VCS gives all 90 Reciprocal cards equal availability at one set-wide 1:4 rate; historical R61-R90 1:11 scarcity is intentionally flattened. R61-R90 retain Futuristics subset metadata.

productSets.name: UD Authentics
productSets.notes: 13-card autograph set, inserted 1:144 packs. Ben Davis, Derek Jeter and Manny Ramirez were packed as redemptions; EXCH metadata is retained while redemption slips themselves are not modeled as separate collectible cards.

productSets.name: A Piece of History 3000 Hit Club: Roberto Clemente
productSets.notes: Three Roberto Clemente memorabilia/autograph cards distributed through 2000 UD Ionix: RC-B PR350 bat, RC-BC SN5 bat/cut autograph, RC-C SN4 cut autograph. No trustworthy overall pack ratio encoded.
